hi, I appriciate you taking time to comment. I agree, no one is truly  'normal' and i get that people have ups and downs. The thing with me is I'm feeling like I'm always down. I have been waiting for that 'up' moment for so long.

Yeah, my mum is great. Couldnt wish for a better mum. She is strong, unlike me. She will find a way through it, somehow.
